screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy:
I was never unsure of you.
I was lost inside our life.

Choosing each other had answered
the easiest question.

Then life began asking
harder ones.

Some days, love did not tell us
what to do.

Being lost together did not mean
I had chosen wrong.

Commitment answered who.
We are still learning how.

director_storyboard.copy_lock_evidence: The creator supplied six exact slide lines; slides.json preserved them verbatim before the independent observable-card review.
director_storyboard.reviewer_evidence: A fresh collaboration agent received only the six copy-hidden observable frame cards after the v2 repairs and independently returned PASS with image-only causality, continuity and anatomy findings.

blind_cards.visible_setting: A midnight apartment whose walls dissolve into mirror-dark open water.
blind_cards.observable_action: They kneel shoulder-to-shoulder on a dining table floating inside the flooded home while a circular wake turns around them without forward movement; the centered lamp and two parallel resting oars are already secured on the raft.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: Her outer-left palm and his outer-right palm press on the tabletop; their inside hands are hidden and their inside shoulders touch.
blind_cards.gaze: Both look toward the same impossible open water ahead.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They share one depth and one direction at the center of the floating table.
blind_cards.object_state: The table floats; the lamp is secured at center; two oars rest along the outer sides; the doorway frame, low shelf and pale rectangular rug drift far behind; the wake is circular.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: The table, lamp, doorway and shelf are the recurring domestic objects used in later frames.

blind_cards.visible_setting: The same apartment while completely dry and almost empty.
blind_cards.observable_action: They carry the same table through one doorway on one travel axis: she walks backward into the room while he follows forward behind the far end.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: She uses both hands on the near short end; he uses both hands on the far short end; all grips and feet are visible without overlap.
blind_cards.gaze: They exchange a small smile over the tabletop.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They occupy opposite short ends of the table along one believable doorway-to-room axis.
blind_cards.object_state: The lamp waits unplugged, two wooden oars lean against the low shelf, the pale rug lies flat, and a finger-high waterline touches the threshold.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: The floating object and water from frame one are shown here in their ordinary earlier state.

blind_cards.visible_setting: The same room as ankle-deep silver-blue water crosses the floor.
blind_cards.observable_action: She catches the sliding lamp while he lifts the same two lightweight oars tied with an indigo strap, and each uses the other hand to keep the table level.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: Her right hand owns the lamp and left palm the table; his left hand owns the strapped oar pair and right palm the table.
blind_cards.gaze: Their attention splits toward their separate practical tasks.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They stand on opposite sides of one level table and brace it with their hips.
blind_cards.object_state: The lamp is caught, the strapped oar pair is lifted, the pale rug rises from the floor, and water enters below the doorway.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: The water rises, the same table stays central, and the same lamp changes from waiting object to rescued object.

blind_cards.visible_setting: Moonlit open water after the apartment has dissolved.
blind_cards.observable_action: She rows the left oar backward while he rows the right oar forward, producing a circular whirl and no forward wake.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: She owns her left-side oar with both hands; he owns his right-side oar with both hands; both kneel on the table.
blind_cards.gaze: Both look at the spinning water with tired bafflement.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They kneel on opposite ends of the same table-raft and lean into equal effort.
blind_cards.object_state: The table is now a raft, the two oars move in opposite longitudinal directions, and the lamp is secured at center.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: The domestic table and lamp survive the flood while the opposed strokes visibly explain the earlier circular wake.

blind_cards.visible_setting: The same open water moments later at the rear edge of the raft.
blind_cards.observable_action: While sharing an exhausted laugh, they lift both dripping blades clear of the water and pause the complete oars at identical forward catch positions on opposite outer sides with shafts exactly parallel.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: All four hands and both complete oars are visible: she owns only the left-side oar with two hands and he owns only the right-side oar with two hands; their shoulders touch.
blind_cards.gaze: Their eye-lines reconnect during the shared laugh.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They kneel shoulder-to-shoulder at the same rear edge instead of opposite ends.
blind_cards.object_state: The complete oars are fully out of the water at matched forward catch positions as the circular wake widens and softens; the centered lamp remains clear of both shafts.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: The circular failure remains visible while the exact matched start pose for the next stroke is established.

blind_cards.visible_setting: Pale-peach dawn over open water with no visible shore.
blind_cards.observable_action: They sweep two oars backward in the same phase on opposite outer sides, making two straight wakes that carry the raft through a break in the old circle.
blind_cards.hands_and_contact: Each uses a complete two-handed grip on their own oar while both kneel on the table.
blind_cards.gaze: They exchange a small side glance while continuing the synchronized stroke.
blind_cards.body_blocking: They kneel side-by-side at the rear of the same raft facing one open horizon.
blind_cards.object_state: Two straight parallel wakes exit the old circle; the centered lamp is dim at dawn and the same doorway frame, low shelf and pale rug fade far behind.
blind_cards.camera_view: Rear three-quarter medium-wide just above water level.
blind_cards.visible_continuity: The oar realignment from frame five visibly becomes coordinated thrust while the table and lamp remain unchanged.

director_storyboard.physical_event: They carry one table into a dry home, secure a lamp and two oars as water rises, turn the table into a raft, spin through opposed strokes, reset both oars together and make one synchronized stroke through the old circle.
director_storyboard.emotional_arc: Shared certainty meets accumulating demands, equal but conflicting effort, reciprocal recognition, and one earned coordinated experiment.
director_storyboard.relationship_change: They move from mutual arrival through divided methods into an observable shared reset and equal continuation.
director_storyboard.sequence_read: A flash-forward previews the circle; chronology then introduces every recurring object, raises the water, explains the circle, shows the matched reset and pays it off with two straight wakes.

setup_payoff_ledger.payoff: Both complete oars pause at identical catch positions and then create two straight parallel wakes through the old circle.
setup_payoff_ledger.changed_meaning: The same effort changes from disorienting torque to coordinated experimentation without promising a known destination.

setup_payoff_ledger.setup: The table, lamp, doorway, shelf and pale rug begin as ordinary parts of one dry room.
setup_payoff_ledger.payoff: The table becomes the raft, the lamp becomes its center, and the exact doorway, shelf and rug dissolve far behind at dawn.
setup_payoff_ledger.changed_meaning: A familiar shared home becomes unfamiliar life while the chosen partnership remains recognizable.
